messages:
Nina Gomez: FYI we're planning a brief pre-embargo note to top-tier analysts 1 hour before publish for the April bench article. Need legal sign-off for NDA copy.
Alex White: What's the specific ask for NDA? We usually do a single-paragraph embargo note.
Nina Gomez: Draft note here: https://docs.internal/redwood/analyst-embargo-note. It mentions high-level perf numbers (e.g., 5x throughput improvement) — legal flagged that as a relative claim and wants source data attached.
Priya Nair: I can attach the full methods appendix and CSVs. Do we have a short blurb explaining methodology for non-technical analysts?
legal-bot: Legal review required. Suggested edits: 1) add qualifier "on comparable instance types"; 2) remove raw per-model cluster configs; 3) add attribution line for third-party hardware. Please ack.
Nina Gomez: Acknowledged. Priya please attach appendix and I'll send to the analyst list at T-1h if legal confirms.
Alex White: PressOps: when you blast the embargoed list, include a link to the methodology appendix (read-only). Don't attach raw CSVs directly in the email.
PressOps Bot: Ready to send on Nina's mark. Will queue the email for T-1h once docs are finalized. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
